tests: pinned devtools package installs without engine warnings on Node 22, 24, and 26
packed aios artifact passes help, version, doctor, and provenance on all supported majors
platform-specific user paths and absolute AIOS_CONFIG_DIR overrides
workspace non-secret schema and unknown-field preservation
same-directory atomic write, snapshot, and failure preservation
complete-source precedence without cross-root field assembly
incomplete higher-precedence root stops with AIOS_E_CREDENTIAL_INCOMPLETE
diagnostics never expose resolved secret values
remote destinations require HTTPS before credentials are attached
AIOS_ALLOW_INSECURE_LOOPBACK=1 permits only credential-free literal loopback HTTP
redirect destinations are revalidated and credentials never cross origins
JSON mode emits exactly one stdout value and diagnostics only on stderr
stable core error codes map to the declared exit classes
every failure exposes one actionable remediation
legacy linear and slack delegates warn only on stderr while preserving canonical stdout and exit status
migration state transitions are atomic and idempotent
re-entry from every non-committed state converges or restores the snapshot
rollback reinstalls the exact recorded package and last-known-good config

adapter.devtools.responsibility: Pinned lazy implementations for build, spec, findings consolidation, ship and roadmap-run behind aios.
